content.text: , as a process note, can you please move the your tickets into the "Review" state when you have finished development.
This ticket is pending response to code review comments.
I don't believe I am able to edit tickets. Or perhaps I am missing a button somewhere?
You should have some additional permissions now or shortly.
I now see a "Start|Stop Work" button that toggles the status between "Open" and "In Progress". Is there a different button for setting the state to "Review"?
Can you "Start" work, then move to "Review" from there?
I am able to "Start" work, but after that, the only option is to "Stop" work, which puts it back into the "Open" state. No option for review.
Try logging out and back in. You should have a button: "Start Review"
The PR has been updated and is ready for further review.
@awoods - I put the ticket into "In Review" state (I selected "ready for testing"). Is that correct?

The fcrepo-camel component with throw exceptions when the underlying http client encounters errors. The exception that is thrown uses an exception class from camel-http4, which is only a moderately good fit for fcrepo-camel. Since other camel component libraries tend not to have these cross-component dependencies, I think that it would be a good idea to remove the reliance on camel-http4 and implement the Exception class internally.
